structuredOutputs.uncertainties: The strongest directly readable primary source available here for the last private round is incomplete: the company page clearly shows a '$600 million investment' led by Coatue and Tiger Global, but the page read did not expose the full body text/date. Reuters independently confirms the round was the 2021 Series E led by Coatue Management and Tiger Global, and Google's indexed company snippet states that $200 million of the $600 million package was secondary, implying $400 million of primary venture equity. I therefore report the latest round amount as $400,000,000 and the announcement date as 2021-10-27, but note that the secondary/primary split and exact announcement date rely partly on search-result snippet evidence rather than a fully scraped primary text. I did not find evidence of any later private venture round after the 2021 Series E and before the May 2025 IPO. For lifecycle, I found affirmative evidence of the IPO and later NYSE-listed status; I did not find evidence before the 2026-09-30 cutoff that Hinge Health was acquired, went private, or closed. The August 2026 Cylinder Health deal was announced as expected to close in Q3 2026, but I did not separately verify closing before the cutoff; that affects Cylinder, not Hinge Health's own lifecycle status.
